title: National Education — measured pilot

ownership.note: Directory host association plus observed trusted redirect and institutional identity. Legacy portfolio titles in directories may differ; no endorsement implied.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, up to three declared attempts per each of 3 predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Per-pair successful-run counts and any unattempted runs are explicit; a collection stop is not a website failure. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: 18 timing attempts recorded of 18 planned; 0 unattempted after collection limits.
3 distinct predeclared core page(s), with three attempts per page/device. Missing roles and narrower samples are not equivalent to complete website coverage.
homepage: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
contact: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
service-information: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
No enquiry was submitted. Search, downloadable competition documents, multilingual equivalence and complete citizen-service delivery were not established.

Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 9 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 12 assessed budget points. 3/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 32 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 2 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

findings.title: Mobile homepage loading
findings.detail: Median lab LCP 21.44 seconds, range 18.19–24.08 seconds across three successful simulated runs. This operator-network result is not a field percentile or every visitor's experience.

findings.title: Carousel controls lack accessible names
findings.detail: The normal-browser homepage review confirms unnamed previous/next controls. Name buttons programmatically and review the repeated unnamed image links.

findings.title: Small-text contrast needs adjustment
findings.detail: Dated news links use #777777 on white at 14px normal weight, just below the 4.5:1 threshold. Darken these text styles.

findings.title: Competitions page needs task-specific guidance
findings.detail: The declared competitions page shows recent-news and archive widgets; the sampled content does not establish clear competition instructions or a completed application journey.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The declared HTTP entry upgraded to trusted HTTPS without an observed downgrade. Credit is limited to this captured entry chain.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: Normal hostname/chain/date-verified HTTPS succeeded on every declared core page. This does not enumerate supported protocols or ciphers.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Captured HSTS policies were parsed against the frozen rule: full requires max-age at least one year with includeSubDomains; a valid positive narrower policy earns half; absent, disabled or malformed earns zero. Worst declared page governs.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: Reviewed the retained successful document response headers together with the same-capture HTTP-equiv meta policies: at least one declared page has neither an enforcing Content-Security-Policy header nor a CSP meta policy. That verified absence prevents meaningful-policy credit for the sample; it does not demonstrate an exploitable vulnerability.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: Reviewed nosniff, DENY/SAMEORIGIN or restrictive frame-ancestors, and explicit meaningful Referrer-Policy values. Full needs all three protections, half some, zero none; worst sampled page governs.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Flags of observed cookies. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: Reviewed the captured response Server/X-Powered-By fields and generator metadata on all three representative core documents. No software product/version disclosure was established in this specific header/metadata sample. Full criterion credit is sample-bounded and does not assert a modern, patched or vulnerability-free stack.

rows.label: No obvious sensitive configuration exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Passive eligible-page review only; no guessed sensitive paths. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Third-party tracking and technical privacy restraint
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Request inventory plus tracking classification. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Largest Contentful Paint
rows.reason: Worst page/device median lab LCP 21442 ms; full/half limits 2500/4000 ms. Not field p75.

rows.label: Responsiveness
rows.reason: Worst median lab TBT 194 ms; full/half limits 200/600 ms. Explicit lab proxy, not field INP.

rows.label: Cumulative Layout Shift
rows.reason: Worst median lab CLS 0.4828; full/half limits 0.1/0.25. Sampled navigation only.

rows.label: Server response and first content
rows.reason: Worst median FCP 4662 ms and document response audit 723 ms. Full 1800/800; half 3000/1800. Response excludes connection/redirect time.

rows.label: Resource and page-weight efficiency
rows.reason: Worst median transfer 5907747 bytes, 93 requests. Full decimal 2MB/80; half 4MB/150.

rows.label: Performance consistency
rows.reason: Largest repeated within-page/device max/min LCP ratio 1.56; full/half 1.5/2. Operator network sample only.

rows.label: Verified WCAG 2.2 issue set
rows.reason: Reviewed DOM and normal-browser axe corroborate unnamed previous/next carousel buttons (.owl-prev and .owl-next): no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title. Repeated unnamed image links also occur. These concrete control-name failures prevent issue-set credit; this is not a complete WCAG audit.

rows.label: Color contrast
rows.reason: Reviewed dated-news text is normal 14px #777777 on #ffffff, approximately 4.478:1, below 4.5:1. The repeated small-text defect earns partial sample credit; logos and unverified background images are not counted.

rows.reason: Reviewed the retained normal-browser core-page screenshots at 320/390 CSS px alongside the additional 320/390/844 px dimension records. The sampled header, primary text and relevant contact/service/organization content reflow within the viewport and remain visually usable in the captured states. This is a manual layout review, not an award from width alone. Third-party embed exclusions are not treated as intrinsic layout defects or completed service tests.

The contact form shows readable persistent labels, name/email/subject inputs, a message area and a visible submit control within each tested viewport. rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Eligible crawl plus manual validation; explicit sample is not a full crawl. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Meaningful page titles and metadata
rows.reason: The retained homepage, contact and institutional/service documents have useful role-specific titles, but their captured description metadata are absent. Partial credit recognizes the titles while recording the repeated missing summaries; this is a three-page metadata review, not a search-engine ranking prediction.

rows.label: Sitemap/crawlability configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: robots.txt and sitemap.xml observations. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Clean URLs, canonicalization and redirects
rows.reason: Reviewed the actual canonical values and final URLs for all three declared core documents, with the retained redirect chains. Each canonical resolves to the same intended page, allowing the observed www alias and equivalent percent encoding. No downgrade, redirect loop or conflicting canonical target was established in this bounded sample. This does not certify all routes.

rows.label: Functional site search and discoverability
rows.reason: Opened an actually observed same-origin GET search form with the benign Arabic keyword وزارة. The captured 200 response identifies the query and presents relevant matching results, including ministry mathematics-team achievements and ministry administration notices. Reviewed the result text rather than inferring functionality from the input. Credit is for this one successful query, not all search terms or every result destination.

rows.label: No critically outdated public technology
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Passive fingerprint plus verified support status. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Cross-page technical consistency
rows.reason: Compared the rendered core-page sample: ministry identity, readable text encoding, navigation shell and institutional context are retained between page roles. No template/encoding failure was established in that retained comparison. This limited consistency check does not certify all routes or browsers; separate metadata, ARIA, resource and layout findings retain their own scores.
